meta.title: Novel Shelf
meta.description: Read local TXT novels in the DSH right sidebar, with an AI companion that roasts whatever you just read — on a timer or on demand, four styles, a character and speech bubble floating in the corner. Pick any model provider registered in DSH, or your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint and API key; off by default. Three novels ship in the box, and chapters, progress and themes are shared with the desktop novel-reader app.
